  "ferramenta": "image_gen integrada",
  "referencia": "assets/art/garden/source/objetos-v1.png",
  "prompt": "Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished CHARACTER ART REVIEW SHEET for three new tiny enemies of a hand-painted storybook garden platform game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, especially existing cute ant and caterpillar rendering; do not copy existing characters, tree or platforms. Square sheet with SIX clearly separated creature illustrations in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS on a plain warm ivory background, generous space between drawings, no scene, no scenery. All poses share consistent illustration detail, warm light, soft painted volumes and clean silhouettes suitable for later game sprites. Each row has one small unobtrusive Portuguese heading above its pair, exactly: 'ABELHINHA', 'BESOURO', 'MINHOCA'. TOP ROW: same small plump honeybee in two poses, LEFT hovering in strict side view facing right with round fluffy golden thorax, yellow and dark-brown striped abdomen, six tiny tucked legs, two antennae, small expressive brown eyes, delicate translucent paired wings lifted; RIGHT low swooping flight facing right, body almost horizontal slightly nose-down, wings swept into a different clear beat pose, focused mischievous expression, round readable HEAD TOP suitable for a jump-on-head game mechanic. Cute and lively, not scary, no giant stinger, no motion blur or swoosh lines. MIDDLE ROW: same compact beetle in two poses, LEFT walking strict side view facing right, low sturdy oval glossy deep navy/forest-green iridescent wing covers with a visible center division, six distinct short jointed legs planted on a common baseline, small rounded head and two antennae; RIGHT three-quarter front view approaching with beetle shell and all six legs readable. Make it unmistakably a beetle rather than ladybug, cockroach or spider; slightly imposing garden bug, without horror, exaggerated horns, fangs or red eyes. Bottom row: same pinkish terracotta segmented EARTHWORM in two emergence poses from a small natural hole among scattered SMALL gray and ochre pebbles. LEFT only short upper section of body curving out of dark burrow opening, round head facing right, subtle expressive eyes; RIGHT more of body raised in a gentle S shape out of its hole, rest stays underground. Earthworms must have NO legs, no antennae, no insect carapace; smooth soft segmented skin and a visible clitellum ring, pink/brown earth colors clearly distinct from game's green caterpillar. Each burrow has a thin irregular soil rim and a few tiny loose gravel stones locally around it, not a floating soil slab or a whole platform. These are design samples, not combat or defeat scenes. Preserve small charming garden creature proportions with enough top-of-head clarity for future gameplay. No girl, fairy, UI, hitbox lines, arrows, grids, extra creatures, giant flowers, watermark or extra text. Do not depict game mechanics as implemented.",
  "resultado": "abelha-besouro-minhoca-v1.png",
  "estado": "Prancha de seis estudos, duas poses por criatura, para avaliação visual. Fundo opaco de apresentação; ainda não é atlas de produção. Sem integração ou comportamento implementado."
}
